title: IconButton
description: A compact button that only shows an icon, plus InteractiveIconButton presets that toggle between two states (favorite, like, bookmark...).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Pass any icon element. The button only contains an icon, so always give it an ariaLabel. It renders a native button with type="button", so it never submits a form.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Without variant the button uses a neutral style; variant applies a semantic color.

sizes-and-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-and-shapes.description: Three sizes (small, medium, large) and two shapes (circle, square).

states.title: States
states.description: Loading replaces the icon with a spinner, active marks a pressed toggle and disabled sets the native disabled attribute, which removes the button from the tab order.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: Override the icon color, background, hover background and active color.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Set showTooltip and tooltip to describe the action on hover and keyboard focus.

interactive.title: InteractiveIconButton
interactive.description: A toggle button that exposes its state with aria-pressed. Control it with pressed and onChange, or leave it uncontrolled with defaultPressed. Its accessible name stays stable (the preset's label, e.g. "Like") and can be overridden with ariaLabel.

interactive-types.title: Interactive presets
interactive-types.description: Every InteractiveIconType, i.e. every key of interactiveIconsMap. Each preset defines its icon, colors, tooltips and accessible label. Click to toggle.

label.title: Label and tooltip
label.description: label names the button and is shown as its tooltip; the icon can be passed as children. appearance sets the fill style.

IconButtonProps.variant: Color variant; a neutral style is used when omitted
IconButtonProps.disabled: Disables the native button and removes it from the tab order
IconButtonProps.loading: Replaces the icon with a spinner and blocks interaction
IconButtonProps.active: Renders the button in its active (pressed) state
IconButtonProps.activeColor: Custom icon color in the active state
IconButtonProps.fillColor: Custom fill color of the icon
IconButtonProps.tooltip: Tooltip configuration (content, variant, shape, arrow); requires showTooltip
IconButtonProps.showTooltip: Shows the tooltip on hover and focus
IconButtonProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label; always set it, since the button only contains an icon
IconButtonProps.children: Icon element, alternative to the icon prop
IconButtonProps.label: Accessible name of the button, also shown as its tooltip (unless showTooltip is false). Takes precedence over ariaLabel
IconButtonProps.appearance: Fill style: ghost (transparent until hovered), solid (filled with the variant color) or outline (bordered)

InteractiveIconProps.type: Preset that defines the icon, colors and tooltips (a key of interactiveIconsMap)
InteractiveIconProps.onChange: Called with the new state after each toggle
InteractiveIconProps.pressed: Active (pressed) state (controlled; pair with onChange); exposed as aria-pressed
InteractiveIconProps.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the toggle; keep it stable, since the pressed state is exposed separately via aria-pressed. Defaults to the preset's label (e.g. "Favorite")
